dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick pale-buff edges on the covert feathers create multiple visible curved bands across the mid-wing section.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale-white boundaries are visible along the edges of the folded tertials and secondary flight feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced and uniform scalloped pattern across the entire visible dorsal surface caused by broad pale fringes on dark-centered feathers.
